notes.title: Fearful Injection - Quality of life improvements & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

- added tabs for the tutorial so information can be accessed more quickly
- fixed several bugs with the physics based pick-up system
- fixed several other bugs
- added a door sound for when the player keeps a door open
- removed an unnecessary key that was unnecessary :(
- adjusted the tutorial text for more clarity
- adjusted some game event timings
- increased pickup and interaction range for the clipboard

Have fun,

Tom
